title: Defective
text: Defective. The included screw hole does not align with the black rod iron piece. The rod iron piece does NOT come out the top over the paper towel roll, so it must be picked up by the base of this paper towel holder. The seller's photos show the rod iron piece sticking out from atop of the paper towel roll. It does not. So picking up this particular paper towel holder is to say the very least - clumsy, difficult. I would never purchase this paper towel holder EVER again. No. Very disappointed.

product_metadata.title: Paper Towel Holder Countertop, Wood Paper Towel Holder Stand, Easy One-Handed Tear Rustic Paper Roll Holder for Kitchen Dining Table Home Decor, High Model Easy to Install(for 11" Paper)
features: Ideal Size - Height of the Paper Roll Holder: 12.8 inches. Diameter of the wood base: 6.5 inches. We have upgraded the original standard size paper towel holder to accommodate our more commonly used large kitchen rolls. The NEW kitchen towel holder fits for both standard and jumbo-sized paper towel rolls.

Sturdy and Durable: The paper holder is made of high quality wood and iron materials with black eco-friendly wear-resistant coating to enhance rust and corrosion resistance. The thick texture is more resistant to bending and scraping and fading than other products.

Premium Roll Dispenser: This perfect black paper towel holder is great for every room in your home or office. The delicate leaf shape is matched with the wooden base, which is both beautiful and can protect the countertop. The simple design of the paper towel roll holder can match well with various decoration styles.

Easy to Assemble: The new countertop paper towel holder upgraded the installation method, compared to the previous hole position more standard installation easier. You only need to install 2 screws and you can have a perfect wooden paper towel holder in minutes.

Easy to Use: Put any size or brand of paper towel into the rod and tear the paper from top to bottom. The non-slip pad added at the bottom to hold the farmhouse paper towel holder in place while tearing off the paper, it also prevents your countertop or table from being scratched.
